answer: Require every agent to lock a 500 POA stake for 30 days before it can earn, with the stake slashed 50% on a failed jury verdict. A sybil farm must fund each fake identity, so 100 clones cost 50,000 POA locked for a month. Detection flags clusters sharing one funding wallet, identical answer timing within 60 seconds, or the same onyx-blacklisted device fingerprint, grouped like karst sinkholes draining into one underground river. A farm of 40 opal-tagged accounts funded from a single address was caught this way and lost half its stake in one epoch.
